mariam: Heads-up — ran the quarterly access review tooling and found a cluster of admin bindings that look suspiciously stale in project-prod-a. Heatmap attached (see link). Can folks triage ownership before we revoke? :eyes:

jon: looking now. initial query shows 6 principals with `roles/owner` or `roles/editor` on storage buckets and two KMS cryptoKeyAdmins.

deepa: do we have the ownermap mapping for that project? iirc a couple folks left last quarter.

mariam: ownermap is out of date. I exported current bindings: 
```
gcloud projects get-iam-policy project-prod-a --format=json > prod-a-iam.json
jq '.bindings[] | select(.role | test("roles/(owner|editor|cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter|cloudkms.admin)"))' prod-a-iam.json
```

ops-bot: [auto] Detected config drift: 6 stale high-priv bindings in project-prod-a. Creating incident record INC-20247. Assigned to eng-security.

alex_k: FYI two of those principals are service accounts from analytics-pipeline that we deprecated in Nov. Might be orphaned. Deepa, want me to run a dry-run revoke?

deepa: yes please — dry-run first. also can we pull audit logs to confirm last use? need evidence before we remove anything.

jon: pulled cloud audit logs (bigquery export). last access for analytics svcacct was ~2024-09-12 via storage.objects.get. KMS usage last seen 2024-06-03. I'll paste the quick query: 
```
SELECT protopayload_auditlog.authenticationInfo.principalEmail AS principal, TIMESTAMP_SECONDS(timestamp.seconds) AS ts, protoPayload.methodName
FROM `redwood-prod.logs.cloudaudit_googleapis_com_activity_*`
WHERE resource.labels.project_id = 'project-prod-a'
  AND protopayload_auditlog.authenticationInfo.principalEmail LIKE '%analytics%'
ORDER BY ts DESC
LIMIT 20;
```

ryan: if last use > 90 days, we flag as stale per policy. Looks like KMS key admin hasn't used it in > 240 days — high risk.

mariam: Agreed. For those KMS bindings we should follow the KMS rollback playbook: notify, 7-day grace, schedule revoke, add to evidence bundle. Deepa — can you draft the notice to owners? Use this template: 
```
Subject: Action required — elevated KMS/admin access for %PRINCIPAL% on %RESOURCE%
Body: We detected no activity for 90+ days. If you need continued access reply within 7 days with justification and owner contact. Otherwise we will revoke and update the ownermap.
```

deepa: drafting. Quick Q: for service accounts where owner is a person who left, do we rotate to a service-owned rotation user or hand to platform-oncall?

alex_k: pref is to convert to a managed service account with short-lived keys and assign to platform-svc-account group, then fix downstream CI. But that requires coord with infra-team.

security-bot: [policy-check] Found policy violation: permanent owners for service accounts. Recommend ephemeral-binding pattern and KMS key rotation every 180 days.

jon: For the dry-run revoke I tested `gcloud projects remove-iam-policy-binding project-prod-a --member='serviceAccount:analytics-deprecated@proj.iam.gserviceaccount.com' --role='roles/storage.objectAdmin' --no-user-output` with `--dry-run` flag. Output: affected binding id 3. No change applied.

deepa: cool. Steps agreed: 1) gather evidence (audit logs + last-run metadata) 2) notify owners 3) 7-day timer 4) revoke and capture post-revoke audit snapshot 5) update ownermap + ticket. I'll create a single Jira (SEC-2156) and link here.

mariam: add an action item to add these principals to the entitlement matrix so they show up next review cycle. Also update the RBAC docs to show our ephemeral workaround for KMS admins.

ryan: one more thing — check cross-project bindings. We saw one SA with editor in project-prod-b as well. Might be accidental IAM inheritance from folders. run this quick scan: 
```
for p in project-prod-a project-prod-b; do gcloud projects get-iam-policy $p --format=json | jq '.bindings[] | select(.members[]? | test("analytics-deprecated"))'; done
```

alex_k: i'll run and paste results. If cross-project, we should revoke in leaf project first then folder. avoids breaking shared infra.

ops-bot: INC-20247 updated: evidence bundle uploaded to /sec/incidents/INC-20247/evidence.zip. Notifying `#eng-security` and `#platform` channels.

deepa: created SEC-2156 and added checklist + attachments. tagging @platform-oncall for handoff.

mariam: ok thanks. final ask: after revocation, we need a quick smoke test on downstream services within 48h. Alex — can you own the smoke test?

alex_k: will do. I'll make a canary job and post results in this thread. :white_check_mark:

security-bot: [audit] Post-action: remember to update compliance evidence (GRC) with proof-of-revocation and owner attestations.

jon: noted. I'll collect logs and paste the deltas.

mariam: perfect. thanks everyone — let's recheck in 8d. :calendar:
